scope: Focused four-host numeric backward-prefix evidence. Identical ARC programs and compiler; the control only extends the backward prefix to the full recorded tape. Workspace reuse is disabled. binaryInspection.scope: Inspected emitted native disassembly for bounded f129/_f129 on all four hosts. Output validation computes the maximum node prefix in a register; the allocation path uses that bound and the reverse loop compares it against input count. Retained assembly is in each runner artifact under prefix/bounded.asm.
binaryInspection.linuxAMD64: f129: max bound in rbp via cmovge; allocation count passed through r13; cmp r12,rbp guards the reverse loop.
binaryInspection.linuxARM64: f129: csinc updates x26; calloc receives count via x22; cmp x26,x24 and b.le skip the unused suffix.
binaryInspection.macOSARM64: _f129 uses bounded count for calloc and bzero; the reverse-loop entry compares the prefix with the input count.
binaryInspection.macOSAMD64: _f129 uses the computed count for calloc and byte clearing, then tests the prefix against the input count before the reverse loop.
